calls.video_title: Unfortunate News for Rocket Lab Stock Investors | RKLB Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: $53 (stated current, after ~10% fall on the day); fair value $22 (stated)
calls.thesis: AVOID / not a buying opportunity — reiterates his 2 Sep stance: Neutron's first launch delayed again, to 2027 (forward propellant dome manufacturing issue), stock down ~10% on the day, -23% YTD and ~66% below the $150 SpaceX-IPO euphoria high; DCF fair value $22 vs $53 market is still far too expensive, wait for a better entry. Prior tracked Parkevtate RKLB entry was UNCERTAIN (12 Oct, overvalued assessment) — no flip vs an explicit stance.
calls.base_case: $2.3B+ cash and short-term investments should carry the company to the next milestone; the delay is not a death knell — rocket development is inherently uncertain and schedules are goals, not guarantees.
calls.bull_case: One of the most innovative companies in the world with a strong balance sheet; a successful Neutron launch would compete with SpaceX Falcon 9.
calls.bear_case: Repeated Neutron slips (unveiled 2021 targeting 2024, then mid-2025, 2026, now 2027; a first-stage tank ruptured in Jan testing); 23.5x forward sales; one of the riskiest stocks in the market, so the risk/reward is not yet attractive.
